from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
sq=np.sqrt(P); vy=np.var(y)
fams={
 'sqrtP_sin': lambda p: p[0]*sq+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*sq*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'P_sin_lin': lambda p: p[0]*sq+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*P*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'exp_sin': lambda p: p[0]*sq+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*np.exp(-p[7]*t)*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'P2_sin': lambda p: p[0]*sq+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*P*P*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
}

    best=(1e9,None)

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
sq=np.sqrt(P); vy=np.var(y)
base=4.0396*sq-1.019*P*np.sin(0.4199*t+3.1665)
g=y-base
fams={
 'sin': lambda p: p[0]*np.sin(p[1]*t+p[2]),
 'log': lambda p: p[0]*np.log(p[1]*t+p[2]),
 'sat': lambda p: p[0]*(1-np.exp(-p[1]*t))+p[2],
 'tanh': lambda p: p[0]*np.tanh(p[1]*t)+p[2]*t,
 'powt': lambda p: p[0]*np.abs(t)**p[1]+p[2],
 'sinh': lambda p: p[0]*np.sinh(p[1]*t)+p[2],
 'lin_sin': lambda p: p[0]*t*np.sin(p[1]*t+p[2])+p[3]*t,
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
for name,f in fams.items():
    best=(1e9,None)
    for k in range(40):
        x0=np.array([rng.normal()*2,rng.uniform(0.01,1),rng.normal(),rng.normal()])
        try:
            s=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-g,x0[:3] if name not in('lin_sin',) else x0)
            v=np.mean(s.fun**2)/np.var(g)
            if v<best[0]: best=(v,s.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(name,best[0],np.round(best[1],4),flush=True)
